q1: SELECT DISTINCT VIEWER_ID AS ID FROM VIEWS GROUP BY VIEW_DATE, VIEWER_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ARTICLE_ID) > 1 ORDER BY ID
q2: SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM( SELECT VIEWER_ID ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ARTICLE_ID) CNT FROM VIEWS GROUP BY 1, VIEW_DATE ) T WHERE CNT >1

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because Q1 groups by VIEW_DATE, which is not present in Q2. This difference in grouping can lead to different results, especially if there are multiple view dates for the same viewer on the same day.
counterexample_dsp: The difference in results can be observed when a viewer views the same article multiple times on the same day. Q1 will count this as a single view for that day, while Q2 will count each view separately.
